Gaolan.why: Builds data-center liquid-cooling systems (cold-plate and immersion CDUs, piping / manifolds, cold plates, immersion tanks); AI computing liquid-cooling projects drove its H1 2026 growth, so AI data-center build-out directly lifts its revenue.
Gaolan.evidence: Gaolan half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-22-2026): high-power-density device thermal management = data-center liquid-cooling products incl. cold-plate and immersion solutions (room CDUs, piping and manifolds); revenue rose as AI computing-center liquid-cooling projects landed in volume; segment revenue RMB 210,110,127.68, up 53.41%.

players.product: Data-center liquid-cooling systems on the facility side (cold-plate and immersion: CDUs, secondary-side piping and manifolds, server cold plates, fluid connectors, immersion tanks; pump-driven two-phase cold-plate system in development) for leading internet companies and IDC operators, alongside HVDC converter-valve and energy-storage liquid cooling

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 results (half-year report): revenue RMB 493,606,783.96, up 18.16% year on year; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 25,732,649.80, up 12.22%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 24,590,961.19, up 37.86%; operating cash flow RMB -26,364,561.81 (down 134.49%, mainly more cash paid for goods and services). The company says AI computing demand kept being released and computing-center liquid-cooling projects landed in volume, lifting both domestic and overseas revenue of high-power-density thermal products, while a better margin on high-power power-electronics thermal products raised the overall margin. Investment income was RMB 20,541,214.31 (68.14% of total profit), mainly from the associate Dongguan Guixiang.

Segments, H1 2026 (half-year report): high-power-density device thermal management products (data-center and energy-storage liquid cooling) gross margin 11.83%, down 2.15 points, with cost of revenue up 57.24%; high-power power-electronics thermal management products (HVDC converter-valve, flexible AC and drive liquid cooling) revenue RMB 215,407,266.02, down 3.69%, gross margin 37.72%, up 9.77 points; engineering operation and maintenance services RMB 60,150,287.83, up 36.84%, gross margin 36.75%. Overseas revenue RMB 55,571,589.31, gross margin 17.95% (down 37.42 points); domestic revenue RMB 438,035,194.65, up 5.66%. The company warns that in data-center and other computing infrastructure competition is intensifying, with some firms using low-price strategies, so margins may keep falling.
quarterly_data.figure: High-power-density thermal gross margin 11.83% (-2.15 pts); power-electronics thermal RMB 215,407,266.02 (-3.69%), gross margin 37.72%

quarterly_data.signal: Data-center liquid-cooling capability (half-year report): products cover server liquid cold plates, fluid connection parts, CDUs of several models and heat-exchange types, immersion TANKs of several sizes and power ratings and heat-exchange units, forming cold-plate- and immersion-based solutions from thermal architecture design through equipment integration to commissioning and O&M; the company says these products can hold PUE within 1.1 and are ready for volume supply. Core components (air coolers, cooling towers, chillers, canned pumps, water-distribution piping, manifolds and quick connectors) are developed and made in-house. Patents at June 30, 2026: 395 (81 invention patents).

Customers (half-year report): the company says it has long-term stable relationships with customers including State Grid, China Southern Power Grid, C-EPRI, XJ Electric, Shanghai Electric, TBEA, PowerChina, Hitachi Energy, Dongfang Electric, PipeChina, Sieyuan Electric, CATL, ByteDance, Alibaba, Tencent, GDS, BDC, Baidu, Vertiv, Huaqin Technology, Inspur, ZTE, New H3C, VNET, GE, Siemens and ABB, with flagship projects including a data-center liquid-cooling project in Malaysia and HVDC / flexible-DC valve-cooling projects in Brazil (+/-800kV), Rudong offshore wind (+/-400kV) and Saudi Arabia (+/-500kV). In HVDC valve cooling it is a qualified China supplier of Hitachi Energy, GE and Siemens, and says its products are used in more than 40 HVDC transmission projects. Its core customers are large state-owned power companies, listed companies and leading internet companies.

Major contract (half-year report): in April 2026 the company, C-EPRI Electric Power Engineering and the electrical systems branch of Alfanar signed a three-party Saudi Central-South water-cooling system purchase agreement to localize delivery and control costs, changing the total contract value from RMB 361,380,000.00 to RMB 317,340,381.28 (tax included). Revenue recognized in H1 2026 RMB 34,150,371.68, cumulative RMB 82,831,858.40; RMB 108,414,000.00 collected by period end; the contract is being performed normally.

Data-center subsidiary and balance sheet (half-year report): Guangzhou Gaolan Innovation Technology, the subsidiary for data-center thermal products, had H1 2026 revenue RMB 174,427,338.92 and net profit RMB 3,110,614.56. Goods shipped but not yet accepted (inventory) rose to RMB 315,634,881.23 from RMB 171,947,009.02 at the start of the year, and contract liabilities rose to RMB 403,031,889.10 mainly on higher project advance payments. R&D investment RMB 22,626,168.80, up 3.06%.
